skills.name: Groundsplitter
skills.description: Alucard rolls to the target location and slams his blade on the ground, dealing 270<font color='#D58E1F'>( +110% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 2s.
skills.tips: Escape tool, you can use this to jump over the wall Engage tool, you can use this to get closer to the backline Pair this up with your passive to do a ‘Gap Closer’ or ‘Retreat’ Has a pretty neat slow built in, so that you can give chase.

skills.name: Whirling Smash
skills.description: Alucard launches a whirling slash, dealing 345<font color='#D58E1F'>( +120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to nearby enemies.
skills.tips: AOE damage skill made to target surroundings enemy Pretty standard skill with no other effects lolol. Super Low Cooldown at 5 seconds, make use of this skill to always proc your passive

skills.name: Fission Wave
skills.description:
<font color='#404495'>(Passive)</font>: Alucard permanently gains 10% Hybrid Lifesteal.
<font color='#404495'>(Active)</font>: Alucard absorbs the energy of enemies in the target area, reducing their Movement Speed by 30% and Hybrid Defense by 10. Alucard gains 10 Hybrid Defense for each enemy hero hit, and reduces the cooldown of his other skills to 50% for 6s.
<font color='#404495'>(Use Again)</font>: Alucard releases a shockwave in the target direction, dealing 400<font color='#D58E1F'>( +200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies hit.
skills.tips: Gives you insane lifesteal Pretty Dope damage on the last attack Your one skill that allows you to have higher sustain compared any other heroes. Both parts of the skill allows you to proc your passive Lifesteal on different targets differs.

skills.name: Pursuit
skills.description: After each skill cast, Alucard's next Basic Attack allows him to dash to the target's location and deal <font color='#D58E1F'>( +140% Total Physical Attack)</font> Physical Damage.
skills.tips: This passive gives Aluchan the “chasing effect” using your AA after every skills will move you to the target you’re trying to attack. This works on all targets, including Towers so do take note. Always use your AA after every skill to make use of passives extra damage.

items.name: Endless Battle
items.des: Unique Passive - Divine Justice: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3s deals 60% Physical Attack as extra True Damage (1.5s cooldown).

items.name: Warrior Boots
items.des: Unique Passive - Valor: Gain 4 extra Physical Defense for 3s when taking Physical Damage, up to 20.

items.name: War Axe
items.des: Unique Passive - Fighting Spirit: Dealing damage grants 12 extra Physical Attack and 2% extra Spell Vamp per second for 4s, up to 6 stacks. Deal 10% extra True Damage according to Base Damage at full stacks.####[C8This effect is reduced to 50% for Marksmen, Mages, and Supports.]

items.name: Haas' Claws
items.des: Unique Passive - Frenzy: Critical strikes grant 20% Attack Speed for 2s.

items.name: Blade of Despair
items.des: Unique Passive - Despair: Dealing damage to non-Minion enemies below 50% HP increases Physical Attack by 25% for 2s (takes effect before the damage is dealt).

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

builds.tips: Item 1: [Endless Battle] Reason: This is your core item, it will be your only item with lifesteal and thanks to its passive of giving you true damage on your AA after every skill, this could say be one of the best item for Alucard. Item 2: [Warrior Boots] Reasons: This boots, gives you armor every time you gets hit. It’s a pretty good item if you’re always going into the fight. Item 3: [Magic Blade] Reasons: Another core item, This item gives you a “second” lifeline… More like more HP so that you can last longer in a fight. Thanks to the current Burst Meta. This is more important than you think.
